Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the comparative logic of age. Despite correctly identifying the birth dates (Aryeh Ben-Eliezer: December 16, 1913; Jason Pociask: February 9, 1983), the Planner concluded that the later birth date (1983) meant “older,” reversing the correct chronological relationship. The error stems from comparing numeric date values rather than recognizing that an earlier birth year corresponds to being older.
